Those operations can mutate Task state or launch Workers while the Lead is absent, so a Project that meets the one-hour/no-active-Worker parking condition can change Tasks before being parked, contradicting the contract that parking stops without changing Tasks, Notices, or Decisions.","action":"Check the current Lead-absence and idle-worker conditions before any reconciliation or admission that can mutate Project state, and park atomically before those operations; re-read the Project state to avoid racing a Lead/Worker recovery.","rule":"","head":"f352b9ce6c586cc606d0200d5ee97ddeda54f661"}]}
